_comment: Project-level Claude Code settings for Atelier. Committed to git so the Agent SDK (gateway terminal + skills) recognizes this directory as a project root and loads the 15 skills in .claude/commands/. Required on CAI where $HOME and the repo root collide at /home/cdsw — without this marker, setting_sources=['project'] picks up nothing and slash commands like /health-check silently resolve to no-ops.
